caption: The video captures a close-up of a supine patient's face during an oral procedure, eyes closed and mouth held open by a metal cheek-retractor loop on the upper side, with a blue endotracheal tube and a small printed balloon tag resting at the right corner amid teal and blue drapes. A large out-of-focus gloved mass occupies the left foreground and lifts away within the first fractions of a second, revealing a left gloved hand whose index finger pulls the lower lip outward to expose the lower teeth. This hand carries a flat metal blade that shifts from a vertical, blurred orientation to an angled position, its tip settling against the lower incisors. The blade then holds with only slight angular and depth adjustments while the finger continues retracting the lip. A right gloved hand at the upper-right keeps a second flat blade angled toward the mouth, remaining essentially static throughout the excerpt.
